acceptanceCriteria.summary: 14 tests pass and the macOS Release product is universal arm64/x86_64.
The accessible iPhone editor supports CRUD and lifecycle-flushed persistence.
The iPhone prompt exposes the required controls, pace modes, display options, progress, remaining time, and idle-sleep handling.
The dependent Watch remote builds, is embedded, uses tested property-list messages, and controls the paired simulator live.
Team, signing style, versions, bundle relationships, device families, icon, privacy manifests, and encryption declaration match the frozen spec.
No account, monetization, analytics, backend, third-party dependency, or unrelated protected capability was added.
Fresh macOS, iOS, watchOS, simulator build, launch, product, and visual receipts are present.
Physical-device and all mobile upload/submission/release states remain explicit owner gates and are not claimed.
